name: CloudMock Local AWS Emulator
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed local AWS API emulator with S3, DynamoDB, SQS, Lambda and other service mocks, Docker/CLI deployment, test mode and observability dashboard; no software quota or expiry published.
watch_out: Emulates AWS APIs locally; does not provide free AWS cloud resources or guarantee complete service fidelity. Users supply their own CPU, memory, storage and CI infrastructure; validate compatibility for each integration.
